msg.cert.missing: No search certificate has been added yet.
msg.cert.simple: The search certificate is a simple certificate and does not list encumbrances and prohibitions. A certificate "with encumbrances and prohibitions" is required.
msg.cert.kindUnknown: The certificate type could not be confirmed. Check that it is the version with encumbrances and prohibitions.
msg.cert.ok: The certificate is the version with encumbrances and prohibitions.
msg.date.late: The certificate is dated {days} working days from the signing date. The law allows at most 5.
msg.date.boundary: The certificate is within 5 working days only if {holiday} is not counted as a working day. Lawyer to confirm.
msg.date.missing: The certificate date or the signing date is missing, so the five-working-day window cannot be checked.
msg.date.ok: The certificate is dated {days} working days from signing, inside the five-working-day window.
msg.date.pending: The contract is not signed yet. To use this certificate, sign by {date}; otherwise obtain a new certificate.
msg.owners.missing: Registered owner {name} does not appear among the sellers in the contract.
msg.owners.extraSeller: Seller {name} is not a registered owner on the certificate.
msg.owners.shares: The registered owners' shares add up to {total}, not the whole property.
msg.owners.ok: All registered owners are sellers in the contract and their shares make up the whole property.
msg.owners.none: No registered owners were read from the certificate.
msg.property.mismatch: The {field} differs: the certificate says "{cert}", the contract says "{contract}".
msg.property.ok: The property identity matches between the certificate and the contract.
msg.mortgage.noFormA: Mortgage in favour of {holder}{amount} has no matching Form A signed by that lender.
msg.mortgage.formA: Mortgage in favour of {holder} is covered by Form A. Pay only as Form A sets out to be entitled to its release.
msg.formc.signed: The buyer is signing Form C instead of Form A. Form C gives up the right to have the existing mortgage released: the buyer takes the property subject to the mortgage.
msg.memo.found: A {kind} in favour of {holder} is registered{date}. While it remains, Forms A and C cannot be used.
msg.memo.none: No memos or prohibitions are registered.
msg.deposited.found: Another sale contract is already deposited against this property ({holder}{date}). It ranks ahead of this buyer.
msg.deposited.none: No other sale contract is deposited against this property.
msg.title.noSeparate: The unit has no separate title. Burdens on the whole plot apply, and the developer's mortgage cannot be released from this unit until a separate title is issued.
msg.title.unknown: It is not confirmed whether the unit has its own title.
msg.payment.mismatch: The contract sends payments to {contract}, but Form A names {formA}. Payments must go to the Form A account to be protected.
msg.payment.missing: The payment account in the contract or in Form A is missing.
msg.payment.ok: Contract payments go to the account named in Form A.
msg.deposit.overdue: The contract has not been deposited and the six-month deadline ({date}) has passed. The automatic right to specific performance is lost and transfer fees rise by 10%.
msg.deposit.soon: Deposit the contract at the District Lands Office by {date} ({days} days left). Order a fresh search immediately before deposit.
msg.deposit.due: Deposit deadline: {date}. Order a fresh search immediately before deposit.
msg.deposit.unsigned: The six-month deposit deadline starts when the contract is signed.
msg.watch.new: New since the previous search of {prev}: {kind} in favour of {holder}{date}. Pause payments until the lawyer has dealt with it.
msg.watch.newMemo: A memo or prohibition has appeared since the previous search. Forms A and C can no longer be used.
msg.watch.removed: No longer shown since the previous search: {kind} in favour of {holder}.
msg.watch.clean: No changes since the previous search of {prev}.
msg.watch.fresh: A staged payment is due on {date}. Obtain a fresh search certificate before paying.
msg.origin.seller: This certificate was supplied by the seller's side. Download a fresh copy from the Land Registry portal yourself.
msg.origin.inconsistent: This certificate differs from an earlier copy with the same issue date. Check that it is genuine.
msg.outside.planning: Not shown by the certificate: planning permit and certificate of final approval. Lawyer to confirm.
msg.outside.tax: Not shown by the certificate: the seller's and buyer's tax clearance, which can now block a transfer. Lawyer to confirm.
msg.outside.fees: Not shown by the certificate: unpaid local-authority, sewerage or communal fees. Lawyer to confirm.
msg.outside.tenants: Not shown by the certificate: tenants or other occupiers without a registered lease. Lawyer to confirm.
msg.human.review: Needs human reading before relying on it: {reasons}.
msg.indep.notConfirmed: Confirm that the firm acts only for the buyer, not also for the seller or developer.
msg.indep.conflict: The firm also acts for the seller or developer. The buyer should have an independent lawyer.
msg.reason.title: no title or registration number read
msg.reason.undated: an entry without a registration date
msg.reason.disagree: the two independent readings disagree on {fields}

ui.aiNotice: Software, including AI, helped read the Greek documents and prepare this report. Your advocate reviewed every finding and is responsible for it.
ui.translationNotice: This translation is for understanding. Where an official certified translation is required, your lawyer will arrange it. The Greek original prevails.
ui.savedOffline: Saved on this device — available offline.
ui.enterPin: Enter the PIN your lawyer gave you
ui.wrongPin: That PIN did not open this report.
ui.notAdvice: This portal shows your lawyer’s report. For advice about your situation, ask your lawyer.
ui.notify: There is an update on your property purchase. Please open your Katharos portal or contact your lawyer.

glossary: Land Registry certificate showing the owners and what is registered against a property. Must be dated within 5 working days of the contract signing.
Debts and restrictions registered against the property, such as mortgages, memos and prohibitions.
A lender's security over the property for a loan. It stays with the property unless it is released.
A charge registered by a creditor who won a court judgment against the owner. If one appears, Forms A and C can no longer be used.
A court or authority order that stops the owner from selling or transferring the property.
The contract of sale. It must be deposited at the District Lands Office within six months of signing to protect the buyer, and ranks from the day of deposit.
Signed by the lender and the seller. A buyer who pays as it sets out is entitled to have the mortgage released.
Signed by a buyer who agrees to deposit the contract without the release protection. The mortgage stays.
The official record of ownership. Many new units wait years for a separate title.
How Cypriot land is identified on the cadastral map. They must match on every document.
Where contracts are deposited in person (fee €50) and transfers completed.
Confirmation that taxes are paid. Since 2026 the Tax Commissioner can refuse a transfer if the seller or buyer is not tax-compliant.
